data.one_liner: Very fast marker clustering for flutter_map.
data.what_it_does: Provides marker clustering layers for flutter_map to efficiently display large numbers of markers. It offers both immutable and mutable clustering layers depending on whether markers need to be added or removed dynamically.
use_when: You are using flutter_map and experiencing performance issues with many markers.
You want to cluster markers efficiently without heavy animations.
avoid_when: You require built-in beautiful clustering animations out of the box.
strengths: Supports both mutable and immutable marker layers.
weaknesses: Does not include built-in clustering animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you just need basic mapping without advanced marker clustering.
